name: Factory
description: Creation logic centralized behind a dedicated creation method or type.

name: Factory Method
description: A subtype overrides a creation method to decide which concrete type is instantiated.

name: Abstract Factory
description: A family of related factory methods grouped behind one interface.

name: Builder
description: Complex object construction expressed as a fluent sequence of steps.

name: Strategy
description: An algorithm is extracted behind an interface so it can vary independently of its caller.

name: Adapter
description: One interface is wrapped to conform to another the caller expects.

name: Decorator
description: Behavior is added to an object by wrapping it in another implementing the same interface.

name: Facade
description: A simplified interface is introduced in front of a more complex subsystem.

name: Proxy
description: A stand-in controls access to another object (lazy loading, access control, remoting).

name: Template Method
description: An algorithm's skeleton is fixed in a base type while steps are deferred to subtypes.

name: Observer
description: Subscribers are notified of state changes in a subject they registered with.

name: Command
description: A request is encapsulated as an object so it can be queued, logged, or undone.

name: Chain of Responsibility
description: A request is passed along a chain of handlers until one handles it.

name: Repository
description: Collection-like access to domain objects is abstracted behind a dedicated type.

name: Specification
description: A business rule is encapsulated as a reusable, combinable predicate object.

name: Dependency Injection
description: A collaborator is supplied from outside rather than constructed internally.

name: Composition
description: Behavior is assembled by holding references to other objects rather than inheriting from them.

name: Delegation
description: An object forwards a call to another object that does the actual work.

name: Polymorphism
description: A conditional on type/kind is replaced by dispatch through a shared interface.

name: Immutability
description: A type is changed so its state cannot be modified after construction.

name: Value Object
description: A type is defined by its attribute values rather than identity.

name: DTO
description: A plain data-carrying type with no behavior, used to move data across a boundary.

name: Mapper
description: A dedicated type converts between two representations of the same concept.
